title: Does the skill travel to new tasks?
hook: Two toy training portfolios face unfamiliar tasks under explicitly assumed transfer rates.

knows: basic arithmetic and how to compare two stated rules
doesNotKnow: how to locate the assumed breadth advantage instead of treating it as an empirical finding

misconception: Assigning broad experience a larger transfer rate in a toy proves breadth causes better real transfer.
objective: Locate the assumed breadth advantage instead of treating it as an empirical finding.
